default.description: The component features a clean and minimalistic design with a light blue background that provides a soft, calming effect. It includes a white, rounded rectangle that appears to be a text input field, giving it a modern and approachable look. The overall appearance is simple and functional, focusing on user interaction.

An image wrap with a placeholder image is also present, giving the component a more comprehensive and informative appearance.
